name: Entry & Core State
description: CLI/HTTP entry point and the modules/core package: session models, persistence, Bottle REST + HTML GUI, reports, diffs, findings, remediation and shared config.

name: Discovery Layer
description: Network and SAP system discovery: dispatcher/gateway scanning, authenticated RFC operations, default-credential probing, SCC fingerprinting and principal-propagation analysis.

name: Exploitation Layer
description: Concrete SAP exploit modules (10KBLAZE Gateway SAPXPG, MS betrusted, CVE-2020-6287/2022-22536/2025-31324, MYSAPSSO2 forge, Windows LPE, dpmon, DB SQL writers) plus orchestrators that chain them.

name: Post-Exploitation & Attack Chaining
description: Privilege-escalation framework, capability analysis, PSE looting, SSH lateral movement and BFS attack-chain ranking over the discovered RFC trust graph.

name: Data Extraction
description: Decryption and exfiltration of SAP secrets: ABAP RSECTAB/SecStore, Java SecStoreFS, BTP destination service, OA2C OAuth2 profiles and SCC keystore/SSFS harvesting.

name: Protocols Layer
description: Low-level SAP protocol primitives: ctypes wrapper for the NW RFC SDK, RSEC cipher, SAProuter NI tunnelling, unauthenticated RFC system-info probes and SNC helpers.

name: Automation, Scripts & Ops
description: Scripted scenario runner, YAML/JSON playbooks, business-impact scoring, cleanup tooling and the flat-import path injector that glues the modules/* subpackages together.

name: Vendored Tools & Helper CLIs
description: Vendored native exploit projects (efspotato, godpotato, miniplasma, dirtyfrag, ssfs_decrypt, btp_ssh_bridge) and stand-alone helper CLIs used for ticket capture and SSO2 profile checks.

name: Tests
description: Pytest suite plus SCC principal-propagation config and trust-config fixtures used to validate parsers and analyzers.

name: Documentation
description: Project README, legal disclaimer, internal research and implementation-plan notes under docs/research/, and the .understandignore meta file.
